title: Improved practice
content: At this moment the surgery in general is in my opinion providing the best services me and my family have been receiving I would especially thank the reception staff whom deserve a lot of praise as unfair reviews often get highlighted is wrong staff at reception and GP including all clinicians working very hard I’m a very demanding area
real_data_note: Verbatim real patient review (4-5 star), used as a positive practice exemplar for retrieval grounding. Not an authored policy document.
